youtube.title: Na Insaan, Na Janwar, Na Din, Na Raat: Kaise Mara Hiranyakashipu? 🙏 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Asur raja Hiranyakashipu ne tapasya karke Brahma ji se vardan paya ki use na koi insaan maar sake, na janwar, na din mein, na raat mein, na ghar ke andar, na bahar, na astra se, na shastra se. Uska beta Prahlad Bhagwan Vishnu ka bhakt tha, jis par raja bahut krodhit hua.

Jab Hiranyakashipu ne khambhe par prahar kiya, to usmein se Bhagwan Narasimha prakat hue, aadhe manushya aur aadhe sinh. Sandhya ke samay, dehri par, apni god mein rakhkar, apne nakhunon se unhone asur ka vadh kiya. Vardan ka maan bhi rah gaya aur Prahlad ki raksha bhi hui.

Katha ka strot: Shrimad Bhagavata Purana, skandh saat, adhyay aath.
